# Cncf Porter Reviewer

Review Porter using its official documentation and repository in the App Definition and Development / Application Definition &amp; Image Build category. Porter enables you to package your application artifact, client tools, configuration and deployment logic together as a versioned bundle that you can distribute, and install with a single command

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
